title: PLDiv: Measuring Dataset Diversity and Semantic Collapse via Persistence Landscapes
abstract: arXiv:2610.14031v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. translated_title: PLDiv：基于持续景观度量数据集多样性与语义坍缩
translated_abstract: 现代数据管道在模型训练和评估中越来越多地将人类创建与人工整理的数据与AI生成的数据相结合。随着数据集规模的增长，它们往往增加的是语义冗余的样本，而非扩展语义覆盖范围，从而损害整个数据集的质量。现有的多样性指标主要概括词汇变化、熵或成对相似性，但对底层数据分布形状的刻画能力有限。本文提出了PLDiv，一种源自持续景观的多样性指标，它从数据的几何表示出发量化数据集的结构组织。PLDiv概括了当邻近样本逐步连接时数据邻域的演变方式，产生一个可解释的结构多样性标量度量，且无需任务特定的监督。无论是测量文本生成或图像嵌入中的内在多样性，还是检测……
tldr: 本文提出PLDiv，一种基于持续景观的无监督多样性度量方法，通过量化数据几何表示中邻域结构的演变来衡量数据集多样性并检测语义坍缩。
en_tdlr: PLDiv is an unsupervised diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset's geometric representation to measure diversity and detect semantic collapse.
